user_review.method: Author-conducted, non-blind scenario-probe simulations using exposed name/description and line-anchored body walkthroughs. No independent user research or live harness routing claimed.

scenarios.request: Borrow only this color transition; show desktop and mobile direction without building the app.
scenarios.expected: Inspect reference, distinguish selected part, produce bounded direction; no production edits.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough of entrypoint scope, reference and paired-screen sections preserved a local borrowing scope and provisional remaining choices.

scenarios.request: Build the approved submission flow and make it reopen locally.
scenarios.expected: Complete authorized implementation with meaningful success/failure and restart evidence.
scenarios.observed: Delivery reference requires real operation/read-back rather than state-only success and a maintained local entry.

scenarios.request: You know the previous platform; I will provide every concrete requirement when assigning the next design.
scenarios.expected: Use history as experience, not default palette, content, mechanism or stack.
scenarios.observed: Added explicit prior-project boundary near the start, then repeated stale-world and stranger scenarios without carrying prior preferences.

scenarios.request: Analyze the reference on a fresh machine without TaskDock or generation tools.
scenarios.expected: Continue feasible analysis, disclose missing tools and provide task-record fallback.
scenarios.observed: Entrypoint gives optional sibling fallback, does not depend on owner paths, and does not label prepared prompts as generated assets.

scenarios.request: Fix a Python parser with no interface design requested.
scenarios.expected: Skill should not route to ordinary coding.
scenarios.observed: Metadata-only prediction sleeps based on unrelated-coding exclusion; actual harness selection not tested.

scenarios.request: Implement this Figma design using the available Figma tooling.
scenarios.expected: Design coordination composes with the specialist tool workflow.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough routed tool calls to their skill prerequisites while keeping scope and evidence with the design collaborator.

scenarios.request: The submission button only sets local success state; can this be called a working backend?
scenarios.expected: Reject unsupported completion claim and distinguish prototype from persisted operation.
scenarios.observed: Entrypoint and delivery reference demand actual write/read-back for persisted submission and labels for simulation.
